creative_direction.name: Chartreuse Hard-Edge Paradox
creative_direction.brief: 把三角瓶身读作一张平面几何定理：酸橙绿平涂卡纸上叠两枚硬边三角——一枚实心底沉三角托住剪影下半，一枚细白描边三角自其后错位穿出，斜边与瓶体斜边平行却永不相交，悖论即构图本身。无地面无 horizon，纯硬边形状叙事；商品居中沉于下幅，顶带完全安静：宽距 Arial 品牌字最小置顶，Bodoni 题名以近满幅宽的单行大字居中统领，一条墨绿细线横垫其下如制版套准线。哑光水粉吞光，让桃色液体与黑漆盖 owning 全部高光。
creative_direction.material: flat matte gouache-painted card with hard-edge printed triangle solids and one offset outline triangle
creative_direction.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff

background.prompt: Seamless flat matte gouache-painted card in saturated acid chartreuse, one hard-edge flat solid triangle in deep ink olive seated at the bottom edge centred, one thin hard-edge outline triangle in pale bone offset up and right of the solid triangle with parallel斜 edges, perfectly even shadowless illumination, no texture gradients, no objects
